ezekiel.11.p1.b1.text: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the LORD that faces east. And there at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men.

ezekiel.11.p1.b2.text: Is not the time near to build houses? The city is the cooking pot, and we are the meat.

ezekiel.11.p1.b3.text: That is what you are thinking, O house of Israel; and I know the thoughts that arise in your minds.

ezekiel.11.p1.b4.text: The slain you have laid within this city are the meat, and the city is the pot; but I will remove you from it.

ezekiel.11.p1.b5.text: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died.

ezekiel.11.p1.b6.text: Oh, Lord GOD, will You bring the remnant of Israel to a complete end?

ezekiel.11.p2.b1.text: They are far away from the LORD; this land has been given to us as a possession.

ezekiel.11.p2.b2.text: Although I sent them far away among the nations … yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries to which they have gone.

ezekiel.11.p2.b3.text: And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them; I will remove their heart of stone

ezekiel.11.p2.b4.text: and give them a heart of flesh … Then they will be My people, and I will be their God.

ezekiel.11.p2.b5.text: And the glory of the LORD rose up from within the city and stood over the mountain east of the city.

ezekiel.11.p2.b6.text: And the Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to Chaldea, to the exiles … I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me.
